headline: Qwen 3.8 rivals Claude Opus for agentic coding, running locally on laptops
summary: A new local LLM, Qwen 3.8 27B, scores higher than Claude Opus 4.6 on a key coding index, enabling powerful agentic coding directly on consumer hardware.
details: Qwen 3.8 27B scores 34 on the Artificial Analysis index for agentic coding, surpassing Claude Opus 4.6's 32. This performance allows it to handle complex coding tasks on a laptop, rivaling frontier cloud models.

The shift to local models marks a significant change from earlier skepticism about AI coding capabilities. Initially, models served mostly as autocomplete tools, but recent advancements enable them to be more efficient than human coders for many tasks.

While Qwen 3.6 27B showed promise, it lacked the quality and speed to replace frontier models. However, Qwen 3.8 27B delivered a significant leap in quality, understanding complex coding tasks and providing accurate solutions.

Despite its initial slowness (10-15 tokens/sec decode), Qwen 3.8 27B completed tasks at a quality on par with Opus 4.6. This allowed users to assign long-running tasks and let the model work for hours or overnight.

The model successfully implemented a huge feature on LlamaStash, a complex Rust project, with minimal intervention. This demonstrated its ability to understand large codebases and deliver quality results, reducing the need for cloud AI subscriptions.

The subsequent release of Qwen 3.8 Flash Next further improved performance. While decode speed remained similar, it reduced overall task completion time by "overthinking" less, making local agentic coding even more practical.

headline: Gemini app is now available for Windows PCs with Alt + Space shortcut for instant AI
summary: Get instant AI assistance directly on your desktop with the new Gemini app for Windows. Use the Alt + Space shortcut to draft documents, manage tasks, or create images without leaving your workflow.
details: The new Gemini app for Windows allows instant AI assistance directly from your desktop. It is available today globally for Windows 10 and 11, downloadable from gemini.google/desktop.

Users can access AI help with a simple Alt + Space keyboard shortcut, opening Gemini over their active work. This enables drafting documents, managing tasks, or creating images without workflow interruption.

The app integrates with Google apps like Gmail and Google Drive, allowing Gemini to pull information for multi-step tasks or project summaries. It also supports generating custom images and directing high-quality video.
Designed to be lightweight and quiet, the app runs smoothly in the background without slowing down the PC. More native desktop capabilities are planned for future updates.
